# dremio_grant (Resource)

One explicit concrete privilege in the experimental OSS RBAC fork. Requires active ADMIN and policy OCC. Uses stable object/principal IDs; never adopts by name. Delete revokes only this privilege, not other or inherited access. ALL, bulk scopes, ownership and versioned refs are outside this resource. Existing grants require import.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Manage only this SELECT grant; other/inherited privileges are untouched.
resource "dremio_grant" "analyst_select" {
  object_type  = "VDS"
  object_id    = dremio_virtual_dataset.report.id
  grantee_type = "ROLE"
  grantee_id   = dremio_role.analyst.id
  privilege   = "SELECT"
}

# SYSTEM is represented by the existing PROJECT enum, not a new object type.
resource "dremio_grant" "create_roles" {
  object_type  = "PROJECT"
  object_id    = "SYSTEM"
  grantee_type = "ROLE"
  grantee_id   = dremio_role.analyst.id
  privilege   = "CREATE_ROLE"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `grantee_id` (String) Stable user UID or role ID, never display name.
- `grantee_type` (String) USER or ROLE.
- `object_id` (String) Stable namespace ID, or SYSTEM for PROJECT. Object recreation requires a new explicit grant.
- `object_type` (String) PROJECT (SYSTEM), SOURCE, SPACE, FOLDER, PDS, VDS or FUNCTION. Server validates the live namespace type.
- `privilege` (String) One existing Dremio privilege enum name, validated against the object type on the server. ALL is unsupported.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Canonical base64url without padding of compact JSON [object_type, object_id, grantee_type, grantee_id, privilege].
- `tag` (String) Observed global policy OCC version.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/sh
# Canonical base64url (no padding) of compact JSON:
# [object_type, object_id, grantee_type, grantee_id, privilege]
tofu import dremio_grant.analyst_select '<canonical-grant-key>'
```
